segments.sn56.15:1.1: “Dhāretha no tumhe, bhikkhave, mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī”ti?
segments.sn56.15:1.2: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn56.15:1.3: “ahaṃ kho, bhante, dhāremi bhagavatā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī”ti.
segments.sn56.15:1.4: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, dhāresi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī”ti?
segments.sn56.15:1.5: “Dukkhaṃ khvāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi;
segments.sn56.15:1.6: dukkhasamudayaṃ khvāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā dutiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi;
segments.sn56.15:1.7: dukkhanirodhaṃ khvāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā tatiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi;
segments.sn56.15:1.8: dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ khvāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
segments.sn56.15:1.9: Evaṃ khvāhaṃ, bhante, dhāremi bhagavatā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānī”ti.
segments.sn56.15:2.2: Sādhu kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, dhāresi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānīti.
segments.sn56.15:2.3: Dukkhaṃ kho, bhikkhu, mayā paṭhamaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ, tathā naṃ dhārehi;
segments.sn56.15:2.4: dukkhasamudayaṃ [dukkhasamudayo (syā. kaṃ.)] kho, bhikkhu, mayā dutiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ, tathā naṃ dhārehi;
segments.sn56.15:2.5: dukkhanirodhaṃ [dukkhanirodho (syā. kaṃ.)] kho, bhikkhu, mayā tatiyaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ, tathā naṃ dhārehi;
segments.sn56.15:2.6: dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā [dukkhanirodhagāminipaṭipadaṃ (pī.), dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ (ka.)] kho, bhikkhu, mayā catutthaṃ ariyasaccaṃ desitaṃ, tathā naṃ dhārehi.
segments.sn56.15:2.7: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, dhārehi mayā cattāri ariyasaccāni desitānīti.
segments.sn56.15:3.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhu,‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yogo karaṇīyo … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yogo karaṇīyo”ti.
